messages.text: So, is the wedding officially confirmed, or are things still being discussed?

What are you talking about, brother? I haven't even secured a job yet, so how could I possibly get married at this stage? I need to become financially stable with lots of Mora before taking such a significant step in my life.

To be honest, I'm still trying to figure out how everything will work out. Finding a suitable job is my main priority right now, and I don't want to make any promises until I have a clearer idea of my future.
I was actually trying to understand the context behind what you said earlier. I thought there might be some news that I hadn't heard about yet.
Come on, tell me the whole story. I'm curious to know what's happening, so give me some background and let me understand the situation properly.
Actually, I had a dream that I had bought a car! For a moment, it felt so real that I could almost imagine myself driving it. Maybe that's why I started thinking about all these things.
That's the whole story, brother. It was just a dream, nothing more than that!
MashAllah! That's a lovely dream. May Allah make it a reality one day and bless you with the means to achieve everything you're working towards.
I sincerely hope it comes true, In shaa Allah. Keep working hard, stay patient, and trust that things will fall into place at the right time.
Ameen, brother. May Allah make it possible and guide us towards what is best for our future.
Assalamu Alaikum, brother! I hope you're doing well. It's been a while since we last had a proper conversation, so I thought I'd check in and see how things are going with you.
Wa Alaikum Assalam, brother! Alhamdulillah, I'm doing well. Thank you for asking. How have you been lately? I hope everything is going smoothly on your side as well.
By the way, how are you getting on with everything these days? Are you keeping busy with your career plans and other responsibilities?

And congratulations on completing your thesis! That's a significant academic achievement, and I know that completing a thesis requires considerable time, effort, patience, and dedication. You must be relieved to have finally reached this milestone.
Thank you so much, brother! I really appreciate your kind words. It was quite a demanding process, but Alhamdulillah, I managed to complete it. I'm glad that this chapter is finally behind me.
I'm doing well, Alhamdulillah. Everything is fine so far. What about you, brother? How are things going with your studies, career plans, and everything else?

I'm doing well too, Alhamdulillah. I'm trying to stay focused on my goals and make steady progress. There are still a few things I need to sort out, especially regarding my career, but I'm hopeful that everything will work out, In shaa Allah.

Are you planning to attend the convocation ceremony this time? Since we're both approaching an important milestone in our academic lives, it would be great if we could attend and celebrate the occasion together.
Yes, In shaa Allah! I'm planning to attend if everything goes according to plan. It would be a wonderful opportunity to celebrate the achievement and meet everyone again after such a long time.
What about you? Are you planning to attend the convocation as well, or are you still uncertain about your plans?
Yes, In shaa Allah, I'm planning to attend too. I think it would be a memorable experience, especially because it marks the end of one stage of our lives and the beginning of another.
In shaa Allah, brother. It would be great if we could both be there and celebrate this achievement together.

I'm glad to hear that. Hopefully, your wish will come true, and you'll get to experience the convocation you've been looking forward to. It's always rewarding to see years of hard work finally recognised.
We should definitely attend the convocation together, In shaa Allah. It would be even more meaningful to share the occasion with a friend who has gone through a similar academic journey.
In shaa Allah, brother! Let's hope everything goes smoothly. It would be nice to meet up, take some photographs, and look back on our university days with a sense of accomplishment.
By the way, where are you staying these days? Are you still living in the same area, or have you moved somewhere else recently?
Why don't you come over to Teyvet sometime? If you're free, we could meet up, have a proper conversation, and catch up on everything we've missed.
I'm currently living in Avengers HQ, so getting to Teyvet takes a bit of planning. However, I'll try to arrange a visit when I have some free time.
Where are you staying at the moment? Are you still in Teyvet, or are you somewhere else now?
I'm in Teyvet at the moment. I'll probably be here for a little while longer, so let me know whenever you decide to come over.
All right, brother. That sounds good. I'll let you know once I have a clearer idea of my schedule.
Try to set aside some time for us to meet one day. It would be nice to sit down together, have a relaxed conversation, and talk about what we've both been doing recently.
Of course, brother! You're always welcome. Just let me know when you're planning to come, and we can arrange something convenient for both of us.
I'm also thinking about visiting the university soon. There are a few things I need to check, and it might be a good opportunity to meet some of our old classmates as well.
I might be here until the 15th, although I haven't finalised my plans yet. If you can visit before then, we might be able to meet in person.
Do you know when the remaining convocation-related formalities will take place? I completed my application quite some time ago, but I haven't heard anything about the next steps.
Have you heard any updates from the university administration? I'd appreciate it if you could let me know whether there's any new information about the schedule or the remaining procedures.
Have you already submitted your application? I was wondering whether you've completed all the necessary steps or whether there's still something left to do.
Yes, I submitted it quite a long time ago. I completed the application well before the deadline, so now I'm simply waiting for further instructions from the university.

I was just checking whether any new announcements had been made. I haven't come across any updates myself, so I thought you might have heard something through your classmates or other university contacts.

As far as I know, there haven't been any major updates yet. However, we've been told to submit our applications by the 15th. Hopefully, once that process is completed, we'll be able to receive our convocation invitations and move on to the next stage.
In shaa Allah. Let's hope the process goes smoothly and that we receive all the necessary information soon.
When are you planning to return? Do you have a fixed date in mind, or will you decide depending on how the remaining work progresses?
I haven't decided on an exact date yet, brother. I might return in about a week, depending on how things go and whether I need to take care of anything else before leaving.
In shaa Allah, brother. Come back safely, and let me know when you're back so we can arrange a meeting.
Anyway, what else is happening in your life? How are things progressing with your personal plans and future prospects?
More importantly, how far have you progressed with the marriage discussions? Have things moved forward since you last spoke to your family about the matter?
We've informed both families about the situation. Now we're waiting to see how they respond and whether everyone can reach a mutual understanding.
At this point, there's not much more I can do except give them some time to consider everything carefully. I hope we can find a solution that makes everyone comfortable.
Have they agreed to the proposal yet, or are they still discussing it among themselves? I imagine this must be an important and somewhat stressful period for you.

The girl's family has agreed to the proposal, Alhamdulillah. That's certainly encouraging news, and I'm grateful that they've responded positively. Now we're waiting for my family to make a final decision.
That's wonderful news, Alhamdulillah! I'm genuinely happy to hear that at least one side has given its approval. Hopefully, the remaining discussions will also lead to a positive outcome.

My family hasn't communicated its final decision yet, though. I'm trying not to jump to conclusions because they may need more time to think about the practical aspects and decide what they believe is best.

Hopefully, everything will work out this time, In shaa Allah. Try to remain patient and have an open conversation with your family. Sometimes, giving people enough time to consider a decision can make a real difference.

In many cases, the girl's family can be particularly concerned about whether the prospective groom has a stable career, a reliable income, and a clear plan for the future. Those practical considerations can make the discussions more complicated.

I honestly don't know how everything will turn out, brother. What I really want is for both families to accept the relationship wholeheartedly. I don't want anyone to feel pressured or agree reluctantly; I'd much rather see everyone genuinely happy with the decision.
For now, I think all I can do is wait patiently and see what happens. Hopefully, we'll receive a clear answer soon, and things will become easier to manage.
In shaa Allah, brother. I sincerely hope everything works out in the best possible way for you and your family.
Don't worry too much. Hopefully, things will fall into place gradually, and both families will eventually reach an understanding that everyone can feel comfortable with.
Please keep me in your prayers, brother. I really hope Allah makes this process easier for us and guides everyone towards the right decision.

By the way, have you started looking for internship opportunities anywhere? Since you've completed your thesis, this might be a good time to gain some practical experience and start building a stronger professional profile.
What about your situation, brother? Have you made any progress with your own career plans, or are you still searching for a suitable position?
Of course, brother. I'll definitely keep you in my prayers. May Allah make things easier for you, open the right doors, and grant you success in both your personal and professional life.
Not yet, brother. I haven't joined an internship so far. I've been considering a few options, but I still need to make a decision about where to apply and how to proceed.

My situation is more or less the same, brother. I've set myself a target of securing a job by December. Once I have a stable position and a regular income, I plan to visit her family and discuss the next steps more seriously.
In shaa Allah, brother. I hope you achieve your target before the end of the year. Having a clear goal and working consistently towards it should help you move in the right direction.

My advice would be not to delay any longer. If you find a suitable internship or even an entry-level opportunity, consider taking it rather than waiting indefinitely for the perfect position. Practical experience can be extremely valuable at the beginning of your career.

I didn't get that opportunity when I needed it most, and by the time I seriously considered an internship, I felt that I had already fallen behind. That made me hesitant to start from the beginning. Looking back, I realise that gaining experience earlier might have helped me build confidence and improve my prospects.

You should seriously consider starting an internship, especially because there seems to be a reasonable demand for professionals in your field. If you perform well, demonstrate a willingness to learn, and develop practical skills, there's always a possibility that the organisation could offer you a permanent position later. In shaa Allah, it could be a good starting point for your career.

Let's see what Allah has planned for me, brother. I'll keep exploring the available opportunities and try to make a sensible decision. For now, please keep me in your prayers and hope that I find a good opportunity soon.

Of course, brother. You'll always have my prayers and support. Keep your confidence, continue working towards your goals, and don't lose hope. May Allah grant you success and make the path ahead easier for you, In shaa Allah.
